info.title: ResearchTools timeline extraction
info.description: Synchronous nonpersistent event-candidate extraction. Operator-provisioned service credentials; no stable event IDs, verification, publication or durable artifacts. Discover support before submitting. JSON Schema byte/calendar/URL annotations require runtime enforcement.

get.description: Require identityType=service, capabilities.timelineAnalysis=true, contractVersions.timelineAnalysis=timeline-analysis.v1 and community.research.execute scope. Omission means unavailable. Discovery limits do not advertise timeline quotas.

200.description: Integration discovery; additive capabilities and versions may be present.

post.description: Requires enabled community integrations and community.research.execute. Full request <=112 KiB UTF-8; supplied text <=100 KiB. At most 64000 selected model-input characters and 100 normalized events. URLs remain required for supplied text. Only 422 content_unavailable permits caller-controlled bounded source recovery. No automatic guest fallback or recovery after auth, network, rate or model failures. Service errors differ from legacy browser errors.

200.description: Events or valid no_events, including extraction/model provenance.

429.description: Middleware rate limit; flat error, not integration-error.v1. Do not scrape again.

serviceBearer.description: Keep server-side. X-Service-Key is a separate rate-tier secret and never grants identity or scope.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller correlation; echoed in discovery and nested errors, not extraction success.

ServiceError.description: Nested integration-error.v1; use code/retryable/requestId, never infer scrape recovery from generic failure. Codes: 400/413 invalid_request; 401 authentication_required/invalid_service_token/expired_service_token; 403 scope_denied/workspace_denied; 405 method_not_allowed; 422 content_unavailable; 500 internal_error; 502 upstream_invalid_response.

Unavailable.description: 503 auth_datastore_unavailable, or flat middleware error with retryable=true.
